newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW extends chief exec Piech's contract.
newsitem.headline: VW extends chief exec Piech's contract.

text.p: Germany's Volkswagen AG said on Friday it would renew chief executive Ferdinand Piech's contract for another five years, starting January 1, 1998.

The car maker also said management board member Martin Posth would leave the company, ending 25 years with VW, on April 5 1997. Robert Buechelhofer would take over Posth's responsibilities for the Asia Pacific region.
Finally Jen Neumann's contract as VW board member would also be renewed for another five years from January 1998.
The decisions were taken at a VW supervisory board meeting on Friday.
Volkswagen said Posth, a board member for nine years, was leaving the company "by mutual agreement."
In its statement, the supervisory board thanked Posth for his services to VW, and noted in particular his successful efforts to expand the company in Shanghai.
Sources in the German car industry have frequently spoken of clashes between Posth and Piech over the past few years, but there has been no confirmation of this.
